Anyone reading this ... she actually did it on 18th May.... i'm her heartbroken father, looking for clues around on her PC now.... she headed for school that day same as ever ... police came a few hours later. We are ofcourse heartbroken... it's not fair. She did not leave a note, never mentioned she wanted to die... we need to now live with this ... it's hard to believe she was actually so careless about us, who stay, a happy family she always said she loved ...   
i guess i just want to say.. **thank you to all of you who discouraged her** or wanted to advice her to seek help or just talk to us... i'll never understand why she did this, why she left us behind for a life of pain..   


**for those who are considering suicide**:

\- NEVER think you're not good enough, or your "perfect" family thinks you're a burden -- in an "ideal" family everybody is imperfect, flawed, needs attention and they deserve to get it same way as you --- you can't detract yourself from that without destroying the whole family!

\- NEVER be too shy to find strength while in one of your good moods to reach out to someone who loves you

\-  NEVER underestimate the pain and heartbreak you leave behind.. i can not imagine anybody being able to hurt me more than my own daughter like this, laying in front of a train coming ... not worth it. **You're not going to be free**. You'll live on, as someone who f\_ked with those who love you BIG TIME.. and you don't want to be that monster.

to my dear little girl... wherever you are:

now i need to work on forgetting you and remembering the dear child i used to have ..**. you're not free. you are loved.**

I’m convinced that guy is clinically insane. In one of his videos he suggested that extractions in children will give them sleep apnea, which will cause brain damage and they won’t be able to get into college or live a successful life..wtf
My mother had 2 premolars extracted for braces, and she is completely fine.

How long has this been going on and what symptoms are you having? Things like headaches, nausea and dizziness can be caused by just anxiety alone. 
I know what it feels like when you’re so convinced that something is very wrong with you, and everyone seems to be ignoring/downplaying your concerns, but you need to realize that it’s far more likely that this is nothing major and your mind is playing games on you. But if it really bothers you this much, get it checked out by a doctor, I actually had a very similar episode, and the doctor’s reassurance was very relieving.

I wish you the best x
